scenarios.name: walk-start
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid lane. Forward pressed at tick 0 from standing: the first steps and the lean into the walk.

scenarios.name: walk-steady
scenarios.note: Suited, across the grid. Forward held; the stills start at tick 60, past the start-up, and span one stride a few ticks apart: read stride length and foot slide against the 0.25 m lines.

scenarios.name: walk-stop
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid. Forward released at tick 60 after two seconds of walking: the last steps, the planted feet and the settle to standing, with the stopping distance on the lines.

scenarios.name: run-start
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid. Run and forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: run-steady
scenarios.note: Suited, across the grid. Run held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride two ticks apart.

scenarios.name: run-stop
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid. Run and forward released together at tick 60: the braking steps and the settle to standing.

scenarios.name: turn-in-place
scenarios.note: Suited, beside the height poles. Turn pressed with no forward; the world-axes camera shows the body turning against a fixed frame.

scenarios.name: walk-turn
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid. Forward with a gentle left turn (about 43 degrees over two seconds, on a 6.7 m radius): the gait bends into the curve and the path stays on the lane.

scenarios.name: jump
scenarios.note: Suited, in front of a height pole (a tick every 0.5 m, a yellow one every metre). A held jump from standing: crouch and takeoff, the apex height against the pole and the landing.

scenarios.name: jump-double
scenarios.note: Suited, in front of a height pole. A second jump pressed in the air spends the last jump and fires the boot jets.

scenarios.name: run-jump
scenarios.note: Suited, on the grid, passing the poles. A jump pressed at tick 45 in the middle of a run.

scenarios.name: flight-takeoff
scenarios.note: Suited, beside the height poles. Flight mode switched on and rise held from standing: the lift-off, the climb against the poles and the pose changing to flight.

scenarios.name: flight-hover
scenarios.note: Suited, beside the height poles. Rise released at tick 60 after a climb: the hover, the exhaust and the idle sway.

scenarios.name: flight-cruise
scenarios.note: Suited, over the grid and the poles. Forward in flight after a climb: the body pitched into the cruise, the legs trailing.

scenarios.name: flight-descent
scenarios.note: Suited, beside the height poles. Descend held from a hover: the drop out of the hover pose and the legs reaching for the ground.

scenarios.name: flight-landing
scenarios.note: Suited, beside the height poles. The touchdown of a descent and the settle on the ground in flight mode.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-start
scenarios.note: Pilot (out of the suit), on the grid lane. Forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-steady
scenarios.note: Pilot, across the grid. Forward held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride a few ticks apart.

scenarios.name: pilot-walk-stop
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the grid. Forward released at tick 60 after two seconds of walking.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-start
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the grid. Run and forward pressed at tick 0 from standing.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-steady
scenarios.note: Pilot, across the grid. Run held; the stills start at tick 60 and span one stride two ticks apart.

scenarios.name: pilot-run-stop
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the grid. Run and forward released together at tick 60.

scenarios.name: pilot-turn-in-place
scenarios.note: Pilot, beside the height poles. Turn pressed with no forward.

scenarios.name: pilot-jump
scenarios.note: Pilot, in front of a height pole. The one jump she has: takeoff, apex height against the pole and landing.

scenarios.name: pilot-step-up-030
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the contact course (the course layout swaps the front camera for one behind and above). Walks up a 0.30 m step and off it again: the foot clearing the edge, the body rising and the planted feet at two heights.

scenarios.name: pilot-ramp-30
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the contact course. Walks up and down the 30 degree ramp: the soles aligning to the slope and the planted feet on it.

scenarios.name: pilot-stairs
scenarios.note: Pilot, on the contact course. Walks up the six-step stair, across the landing and down the five steps beyond.

scenarios.name: step-up-015
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course (the course layout swaps the front camera for one behind and above). Walks up a 0.15 m step and off it again.

scenarios.name: step-up-030
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course. Walks up a 0.30 m step, the tallest riser she climbs, and off it again.

scenarios.name: platform-step
scenarios.note: Suited, on the studio platform (0.3 m tall, 3 m radius). Walks onto it, across and off the far side.

scenarios.name: ramp-15
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course. Walks up and down the 15 degree ramp: the soles aligning to the slope and the body's pitch and lean on it.

scenarios.name: ramp-30
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course. Walks up and down the 30 degree ramp.

scenarios.name: run-ramp-15
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course. Runs up and over the 15 degree ramp: grounded across the crest and descent.

scenarios.name: stairs
scenarios.note: Suited, on the contact course. Walks up the six-step stair (0.17 m risers, 0.3 m treads), across the landing and down the five steps beyond.
